# Repeat With Menu

A backup of the **Repeat With Menu** shortcut. `shortcut.json` is the canonical, diffable source; `shortcut.shortcut` is the signed binary that the Shortcuts app can import.

## Actions

- `0` Repeat 3 Times
  - `1` Choose from Menu
  - `2` Menu Item First
    - `3` If [Repeat Index] has any value
      - `4` Text
    - `5` End If
  - `6` Menu Item Second
    - `7` Comment
  - `8` End Menu
- `9` End Repeat Times
